slides.title: What Happened on Nov 4
slides.body: The day after the midterms, the Dow had its biggest gain of 2026. Democrats won control of Congress, and investors saw less risk of sweeping policy change.

slides.title: Wall Street Closes Higher
slides.subtitle: Nov 4 moves (percent)
slides.body: S&P 500 closed at 7,689. Solar and hospital stocks led. AI data center stocks lagged.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Split power can slow big tax and spending bills, and Trump can still veto. Strategists warn AI data center rules and the 2027 debt limit are risks.
